# kestrel-chartkit golden reference fixture: yield curve difference tests
#
# Reference values generated offline from an independent second implementation; generator,
# pinned version and conventions are recorded in the local project documentation, not in this
# repository.
#
# Conventions: continuously compounded zero rates, linear interpolation in time between the
# nodes, flat extrapolation outside them, Actual/365Fixed. Discount factors are exp(-z(t)*t).
#
# Each curve carries its nodes as node<i>_t / node<i>_rate and its queries as query<j>_t /
# query<j>_zero / query<j>_discount.
#
# query<j>_inside marks whether the query lies within the quoted node range. Beyond the last
# node the reference continues the slope of the final segment, while this crate holds the edge
# rate flat; those queries are therefore not comparable and are marked 0.
